SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ai_chat_topic WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{beginTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`
